problem.title: Count Distinct Binary Search Tree Shapes Generated from Multiple Insertion Sequences
problem.problemStatement: Given M insertion sequences of distinct keys, determine how many structurally distinct Binary Search Trees are produced.
problem.input: • The first line contains an integer M. • For each sequence, the first line contains its length followed by the insertion sequence.
problem.output: • Print the number of distinct Binary Search Tree structures.
problem.constraints: • 1 ≤ M ≤ 10^5 • Total number of keys across all sequences ≤ 2 × 10^5
